options.name: argent-environment-inspector
options.description: Inspects a mobile app project's environment and returns structured JSON covering project type, platform support, build and startup commands, bundler config, env resolution, key packages, QA/feedback-loop tooling, and Argent-specific workflow commands. Works on any project — determines whether it is React Native, Expo, Flutter, native iOS/Android, or another stack, and provides environment context regardless. Has deeper React Native introspection via gather-workspace-data but also reports useful information for non-RN projects. Use proactively at session start when required to gather the environment information. If subagent delegation is not available, run the steps in the main thread instead. The main agent is responsible for persisting the result to project memory.
